messages:
maddie: Heads-up — large customer (fintech) asked for: BYOK, 7+ years of immutable audit logs, tenant-level retention controls, and SOC2 evidence by end of quarter. They want exportability for in-house legal reviews. Deadline = 10/15.
raj: 10/15 timeline is tight. Main risks: storage + index costs for multi-year logs, query latency for long retention, and retention/deletion pipeline complexity.
elena: Security constraints: BYOK means we can't keep plaintext keys. We'll need KMS/HSM integration and a key-escrow/rotation policy. Also need tamper-evidence (hash chaining or signed events) for the 7+ years ask.
tanner: Infra note: we can layer cold storage (S3 Glacier-like) + warm index for recent X months. Search SLA will degrade for cold data unless we maintain secondary indexes. That has cost implications.
olivia: Customer is firm on 7 years + BYOK; they're a strategic pilot. If we miss deadline they might go to a competitor. Can we propose a phased delivery? :crossed_fingers:
maddie: Proposal: Phase 1 (MVP by 10/15): 1 year of audit retention (hot+warm), tenant-configurable retention UI, export API for compliance exports, and SOC2 evidence pack for hosted infra. BYOK gated — ship BYOK preview with limited KMS partners (AWS KMS + Google KMS) and 'bring-key' onboarding docs.
elena: Agree to phase. For tamper-evidence we can implement event signing with a per-tenant HMAC stored in KMS. Full BYOK (customer keys in their KMS) will require extra legal + key-escrow decisions.
raj: Engineering ask for MVP: retention config model, immutable write path, export endpoint, backfill tool for existing logs, and metrics for storage costs. ETA for that scope = 6 weeks if we deprioritize some non-essential console polish.
tanner: I'll prototype cold-tiering + retrieval for exports. Need to define retention TTL semantics + legal-hold override. Also need quota model for long-tail customers.
maddie: UX criteria: retention tooltip + per-tenant dropdown (30d/90d/1y/3y/custom), legal-hold toggle, export history. Launch criteria = audit exports succeed for 95% of requests under 1h for up to 100GB.
olivia: Can we commit to a BYOK roadmap item pinned to Q4 with a clear checklist for security review + contract addendum? Customer accepts phased approach if BYOK timeline is explicit.
elena: BYOK checklist (short): KMS connectors, key usage policies (no key material leave customer scope), key rotation APIs, attestation for hardware-backed keys. Also document incident response changes.
compliance-bot: Link: https://redwood.example.com/internal/compliance/byok-checklist (internal) — add SOC2 evidence matrix to the page.
maddie: Action items: @raj build retention + export MVP (6w), @tanner prototype cold storage (3w), @elena draft BYOK checklist + legal notes (2w), @olivia communicate phased plan to customer and collect acceptance (ASAP). I'll own rollout plan + launch criteria doc.
raj: noted. Putting tasks in board now.
olivia: I'll schedule customer sync for tomorrow to confirm phases and get verbal sign-off.
maddie: OK — we'll aim to ship Phase 1 (1-year retention + export + SOC2 pack) by 10/15, BYOK preview on roadmap for Q4. If anything blocks majorly, we escalate. :raised_hands:
```json
// example retention config (backend representation)
{
  "tenant_id": "T123",
  "retention_policy": "P1Y",
  "legal_hold": false,
  "immutable": true,
  "export_targets": ["s3://acct-exports/T123/"]
}
```
raj: Nice. Reminder: we need migration plan for existing logs and cost estimate for the 7-year scenario before committing to any longer-term asks.
elena: Also recommend we add a cryptographic digest chain in the headers for each event so exports include verifiable integrity metadata.
maddie: Good call. We'll track digest chain as w/in-scope for Phase 1 if it doesn't block. Otherwise Phase 2.
compliance-bot: Policy reminder: retention over 2 years requires product + legal sign-off per internal policy 4.2.
maddie: Acknowledged — looping in legal. End of thread.
